headline: US stocks set for higher open as tech leads futures gains into quiet Veterans Day session with no major data on tap
raw_text:
- S&P 500 futures (@ES) are up 0.67%, Dow Jones futures (@YM) rise 0.19%, Nasdaq 100 futures (@NQ) climb 1.55%, and Russell 2000 futures (@ER2) gain 0.45%, indicating a positive start for US equities
- Estee Lauder (EL) trades roughly flat pre-market after raising its annual sales and profit guidance on resilient demand for premium skincare products
- Rivian (RIVN) trades roughly flat in early trading after UBS (UBS) upgrades the stock to Buy with a $17 price target
- Check Point Software (CHKP) trades roughly flat pre-market after being named a Leader in Forrester's Q4 2026 Enterprise Firewall Solutions Wave report
- Riskified (RSKD) and CGI Group (GIB) are among companies reporting earnings before the bell, with results expected to influence early session trading
- Asian equity markets traded mixed overnight with the Nikkei (@NKD) advancing, while European indices post modest gains
- Oil (@CL) and gold (@GC) prices move modestly with limited spillover effect on broader risk assets
- No major US economic data releases are scheduled today due to the Veterans Day holiday, keeping attention on stock-specific catalysts and tech and AI follow-through
- Yesterday’s modest declines left key technical levels intact, aligning with an upside bias implied by the current futures setup
